removed.asset-429: 픽스처 문제: R1은 static asset을 요청하지 않으며 http-429가 실행 중인 동등 사례
removed.asset-body-with-auth-strings: 픽스처 문제: obsolete asset 모드의 JavaScript 리터럴 무시는 GraphQL checkpoint_url=null에 대한 증거가 아님

p4.behavior: has_key는 값과 무관하게 키 존재로 판정하는 현행 계약. GraphQL의 null 키를 안전하다고 바꿀 플랫폼 증거는 없으며 별도 테스트가 고정해야 함.

about: Response classification (appendix A 1-8). Each case is one response envelope as the browser returns it ({status, url, body}; body_lines are joined with newlines after an optional prefix), how it was requested (mode: graphql | home | html; for graphql an expected key and kind), and the outcome: ok (with the decoded chunk count), blocked (reason checkpoint | rate_limit), login, retry (temporary rejection, one paced retry allowed), failed, or empty (an explicitly empty connection).

cases.name: anti-json-prefix-and-ndjson
cases.fact: A body can start with for (;;); and carry several JSON objects (Relay incremental delivery).

cases.name: checkpoint-by-path
cases.fact: A response whose final URL path is /checkpoint is a checkpoint: an indefinite block.

cases.name: checkpoint-by-key
cases.fact: A checkpoint_url key is a checkpoint.

cases.name: challenge-url-in-html
cases.fact: A challenge_url key in an HTML page is a checkpoint.

cases.name: login-code
cases.fact: Error code 1357001 means login is required.

cases.name: login-form-key
cases.fact: A caa_login_form_data key means login is required.

cases.name: login-path
cases.fact: A final URL under /login or /recover means login is required.

cases.name: logged-out-user-zero
cases.fact: USER_ID "0" is a logged-out page.

cases.name: home-without-user-id
cases.fact: A 200 home page without USER_ID is not a logged-in page.

cases.name: home-logged-in
cases.fact: A home page with a nonzero USER_ID is logged in.

cases.name: http-429
cases.fact: HTTP 429 is a rate limit: a 30-minute block.

cases.name: code-1357004
cases.fact: Code 1357004 is a rate limit.

cases.name: code-1357054-first
cases.fact: Code 1357054 is a temporary rejection: pace, then retry once.

cases.name: code-1357054-after-retry
cases.fact: Code 1357054 again after the retry is a rate limit.

cases.name: errors-without-data
cases.fact: A chunk with errors and no data is a failed query.

cases.name: critical-severity
cases.fact: An error of severity CRITICAL fails the query even with data.

cases.name: chunk-error-key
cases.fact: A chunk carrying an error key fails the query.

cases.name: non-200
cases.fact: Any other non-200 status is a failed request.

cases.name: malformed-json-line
cases.fact: A GraphQL body that does not decode as a sequence of JSON objects is a failed query (records are never built from a partial decode).

cases.name: non-object-json-line
cases.fact: A JSON line that is not an object fails the query.

cases.name: count-only-preview-is-not-the-connection
cases.fact: The expected connection must carry edges, nodes or page_info; a count-only object with the same name cannot paginate, so its absence elsewhere is a stale query.

cases.name: count-only-preview-beside-real-connection
cases.fact: A count-only preview beside the real connection is ignored.

cases.name: expected-key-missing
cases.fact: A response without the expected key at all is a stale query.

cases.name: object-kind-needs-identity
cases.fact: An expected object (the permalink post) must carry id, __typename, comet_sections, feedback or story.

cases.name: object-kind-ok
cases.fact: An expected object with a __typename is a readable object.

cases.name: explicit-empty
cases.fact: Zero items with has_next_page false is an explicitly empty result, not a stale query.

cases.name: empty-but-more-pages
cases.fact: Zero items with has_next_page true is not empty: reading continues.

cases.name: page-info-types
cases.fact: has_next_page must be a boolean and end_cursor a string or null.

cases.name: edges-must-hold-nodes
cases.fact: Every edge must carry a node object.
